name: FaceStation 2
tagLine: Touchless face recognition terminal for hygienic, high-throughput clocking.
summary:
The FaceStation 2 brings touchless biometric time and attendance to South African workplaces, using advanced near-infrared (NIR) face recognition that performs in variable lighting — including direct sunlight common on SA factory floors and outdoor canteens. Employees clock in and out in under a second with zero physical contact, making it the ideal solution for healthcare, food processing, manufacturing and any environment where hygiene is a priority.

The FaceStation 2 supports live-face detection to prevent spoofing attempts and integrates directly with BioStar 2 for centralised workforce management across multiple sites.

features.title: Touchless NIR face recognition
features.description: Near-infrared cameras enable reliable authentication in bright sunlight and low-light conditions.

features.title: Anti-spoofing live detection
features.description: Detects and rejects printed photographs and replay attacks, maintaining high security integrity.

features.title: Sub-1-second throughput
features.description: Handles rapid-fire shift changes without queues — ideal for large manufacturing and logistics sites.

features.title: Hygienic zero-contact operation
features.description: Complies with health and hygiene requirements in food production, healthcare and pharmaceutical environments.
